aria-label.zh-CN: 树的可访问名称，设在 `role="tree"` 的元素上；空状态下不渲染该元素。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the tree, set on the element with `role="tree"`; the element is not rendered in the empty state.

autoExpandParent.zh-CN: expandedKeys 变化时是否自动展开其中节点的父节点；挂载时总会展开。开启后，展开受控时要先收起所有已展开的子节点才能收起父节点。
autoExpandParent.en-US: Whether the parents of the nodes in expandedKeys expand automatically when expandedKeys changes; they always do on mount. When on, a controlled tree collapses a parent only after its expanded children are collapsed.

autoExpandWhenDragEnter.zh-CN: 拖拽到收起的节点上时是否自动展开该节点。
autoExpandWhenDragEnter.en-US: Whether dragging over a collapsed node expands it.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 父节点被选中时，值不再包含它的子孙节点；leafOnly 为 false 时生效。
autoMergeValue.en-US: When a parent is selected the value leaves out its descendants; applies when leafOnly is false.

blockNode.zh-CN: 节点显示为整行，悬浮和选中高亮整行；关闭时只高亮节点的 label。
blockNode.en-US: Shows each node as a whole row, highlighting the row on hover and selection; when off only the label is highlighted.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点之间选中状态的关系：`related` 为父子联动，`unRelated` 为互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: How the checked states of nodes relate in a multiple tree: `related` links parents and children, `unRelated` keeps them independent.

children.zh-CN: 当前实现不渲染 children，树节点请通过 treeData 提供。
children.en-US: Tree does not render children; provide the nodes through treeData.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

defaultExpandAll.zh-CN: 初始化时展开所有节点。之后 treeData 或 treeDataSimpleJson 的变化不再影响展开状态，需要时使用 expandAll。
defaultExpandAll.en-US: Expands every node on mount. Later changes of treeData or treeDataSimpleJson do not affect it; use expandAll for that.

defaultExpandedKeys.zh-CN: 默认展开的节点，显示其直接子级。
defaultExpandedKeys.en-US: Nodes expanded initially, showing their direct children.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 指定默认选中的条目，只在挂载时读取。
defaultValue.en-US: The initially selected items, read once on mount.

directory.zh-CN: 目录树模式，节点默认显示文件夹或文件图标；节点数据中的 `icon` 与 `icon` 属性可以覆盖它。
directory.en-US: Directory mode, which shows folder and file icons by default; the `icon` of a node and the `icon` prop override them.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 严格禁用：禁用的节点不能通过父级或子级的选中关系改变状态。
disableStrictly.en-US: Strict disabling: a disabled node cannot change state through the selection of its parent or children.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用整棵树。节点数据中的 `disabled: false` 不会解除禁用。
disabled.en-US: Disables the whole tree. A node with `disabled: false` does not lift it.

draggable.zh-CN: 是否允许拖拽节点，配合 onDrop 等拖拽回调使用。
draggable.en-US: Whether nodes can be dragged, used with the drag callbacks such as onDrop.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有节点，或开启 `showFilteredOnly` 后搜索无结果时显示的内容，未设置时取语言包中的空状态文案；为 `null` 时不渲染空状态。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there are no nodes, or when the search finds none with showFilteredOnly on. Defaults to the empty text of the locale; `null` renders no empty state.

expandAction.zh-CN: 展开逻辑：`false` 仅点击展开箭头时展开，`click` 单击节点展开，`doubleClick` 双击节点展开。键盘不使用该逻辑。
expandAction.en-US: How a node expands: `false` only through the arrow, `click` on a click, `doubleClick` on a double click. The keyboard does not use it.

expandAll.zh-CN: 展开所有节点，数据变化后仍然生效。
expandAll.en-US: Expands every node, and keeps doing so when the data changes.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义展开图标。传入元素时，Tree 为它加上展开的点击处理与展开图标的类名；传入函数时，参数为 `onClick`、`className` 和 `expanded`，返回整个图标；其他 ReactNode 原样渲染，不绑定展开点击。
expandIcon.en-US: Custom expand icon. An element receives the expand click and the switcher class; a function receives `onClick`, `className` and `expanded` and returns the whole icon. Other nodes render as they are, without the expand click.

expandedKeys.zh-CN: （受控）展开的节点。传入后展开状态完全受控，配合 onExpand 使用。
expandedKeys.en-US: Expanded nodes (controlled). Passing it makes expansion fully controlled, used with onExpand.

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否开启搜索。传 `true` 时按 treeNodeFilterProp 匹配；传函数时自定义匹配，第三个参数为当前节点数据。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether search is on. `true` matches by treeNodeFilterProp; a function customizes the match, with the node data as its third argument.

hideDraggingNode.zh-CN: 拖拽时隐藏被拖拽节点的拖拽图像。
hideDraggingNode.en-US: Hides the drag image of the node being dragged.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义节点图标。传入元素时所有节点使用同一图标；传入函数时每行调用一次，参数为该行的属性（含节点数据），返回该行的图标。节点数据中的 `icon` 优先于此属性。
icon.en-US: Custom node icon. An element is used for every node; a function is called once per row with the row's props, including its node data, and returns that row's icon. The `icon` in node data takes precedence over this prop.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 key、label、value 与 children 的字段名。映射了 label 且开启搜索时，需把 treeNodeFilterProp 设为 treeData 的键之一，或自定义 filterTreeNode。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom field names for key, label, value and children in a node. When label is mapped and search is on, set treeNodeFilterProp to one of the keys in treeData or provide filterTreeNode.

labelEllipsis.zh-CN: label 超出时是否省略；未设置时跟随 `virtualize`，开启虚拟化则省略。
labelEllipsis.en-US: Whether an overflowing label is truncated; when unset it follows `virtualize`, truncating when virtualization is on.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时，值和 onChange 的参数只包含叶子节点。
leafOnly.en-US: In a multiple tree, the value and the argument of onChange hold leaf nodes only.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载子节点，返回 Promise。叶子节点需在数据中用 isLeaf 标明；设置后未标明 isLeaf 的节点显示展开箭头。
loadData.en-US: Loads the children of a node and returns a Promise. Mark leaves with isLeaf in the data; a node without isLeaf shows the expand arrow while this is set.

loadedKeys.zh-CN: （受控）已加载的节点，配合 loadData 使用。

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启展开收起的动画；虚拟化时动画关闭。
motion.en-US: Whether expanding and collapsing are animated; animation is off for a virtualized tree.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否多选。多选时所有子项都被选择会自动勾选其父项。
multiple.en-US: Whether several nodes can be selected. A parent is checked automatically once all its children are.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中状态变化时调用，参数为当前选中的值（多选时为数组）；`onChangeWithObject` 为 `true` 时参数为节点对象。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the selected value (an array when multiple); with onChangeWithObject set to `true` the argument is the node object.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: 是否把选中节点的其他属性一并给 onChange。为 `true` 时参数由 value 变为包含 value、label 及其他属性的节点对象；受控的 value 与 defaultValue 也要传对象，且必须含 value。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: Whether the other fields of a selected node go to onChange. When true the argument is the node object with value, label and other fields instead of the value; a controlled value and defaultValue must then be objects with a value.

onContextMenu.zh-CN: 在节点上右键时调用，参数为事件和节点数据。
onContextMenu.en-US: Called on a right click on a node, with the event and the node data.

onDoubleClick.zh-CN: 双击节点时调用，参数为事件和节点数据。
onDoubleClick.en-US: Called on a double click on a node, with the event and the node data.

onDragEnd.zh-CN: 拖拽结束时调用，参数为 `{ event, node }`。
onDragEnd.en-US: Called when a drag ends, with `{ event, node }`.

onDragEnter.zh-CN: 拖拽进入节点时调用，参数为 `{ event, node, expandedKeys }`；拖拽使收起的节点展开时，`expandedKeys` 为展开后的键。
onDragEnter.en-US: Called when a drag enters a node, with `{ event, node, expandedKeys }`; expandedKeys is set when the drag expanded a collapsed node.

onDragLeave.zh-CN: 拖拽离开节点时调用，参数为 `{ event, node }`。
onDragLeave.en-US: Called when a drag leaves a node, with `{ event, node }`.

onDragOver.zh-CN: 拖拽经过节点时调用，参数为 `{ event, node }`。
onDragOver.en-US: Called while a drag is over a node, with `{ event, node }`.

onDragStart.zh-CN: 开始拖拽节点时调用，参数为 `{ event, node }`。
onDragStart.en-US: Called when a node starts to be dragged, with `{ event, node }`.

onDrop.zh-CN: 节点被放下时调用，参数为 `{ event, node, dragNode, dragNodesKeys, dropPosition, dropToGap }`。
onDrop.en-US: Called when a node is dropped, with `{ event, node, dragNode, dragNodesKeys, dropPosition, dropToGap }`.

onExpand.zh-CN: 展开或收起节点时调用，参数为展开的节点键数组和 `{ expanded, node }`。
onExpand.en-US: Called when a node expands or collapses, with the expanded keys and `{ expanded, node }`.

onLoad.zh-CN: 节点加载完毕时调用，参数为已加载节点的键集合和该节点数据。
onLoad.en-US: Called when a node has loaded, with the set of loaded keys and the node data.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索框的值变化时调用，参数为搜索值和因搜索或 value、defaultValue 而展开的节点键数组；展开受控时可用它展开搜索结果。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the search input changes, with the search value and the keys expanded by the search or by value and defaultValue; under controlled expansion it can expand the results.

onSelect.zh-CN: 节点被选中或取消选中时调用，参数为节点键、是否选中和节点数据。
onSelect.en-US: Called when a node is selected or deselected, with its key, whether it is selected and its data.

ref.zh-CN: 指向 `TreeHandle` 句柄，包含 `search` 与 `scrollTo` 方法，见下方 Methods。
ref.en-US: Points to the `TreeHandle`, which holds the `search` and `scrollTo` methods; see Methods below.

renderDraggingNode.zh-CN: 拖拽时浏览器显示的拖拽图像。参数为节点的 HTML 元素与节点数据，返回一个 `HTMLElement`。
renderDraggingNode.en-US: The drag image the browser shows while a node is dragged. It receives the node's HTML element and its data, and returns an `HTMLElement`.

renderFullLabel.zh-CN: 接管整行的渲染，每行调用一次，参数为对象，含 `data`、`level`、`expandIcon`、`className`、`style`、`checkStatus`、`expandStatus`、`onClick`、`onCheck` 等。返回的元素会被 Tree 加上 `role="treeitem"`、无障碍状态属性与 `style`；返回文本、数组或 Fragment 时由 `li` 包裹。`className` 需由返回的元素自行绑定。
renderFullLabel.en-US: Renders the whole row, called once per row with an object holding `data`, `level`, `expandIcon`, `className`, `style`, `checkStatus`, `expandStatus`, `onClick`, `onCheck` and more. The returned element gets `role="treeitem"`, the accessibility state attributes and `style` from Tree; text, arrays and fragments are wrapped in an `li`. The element must apply `className` itself.

renderLabel.zh-CN: 自定义节点 label 的渲染，参数为 label、节点数据和当前搜索词。设置后不再自动高亮搜索词；搜索仍按 treeData 中的 label 文本匹配。
renderLabel.en-US: Renders a node's label from the label, the node data and the search word. Search words are no longer highlighted automatically; search still matches the label text in treeData.

searchClassName.en-US: Class of the search box container.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索框的占位文字，未设置时取语言包中的文案。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search box; defaults to the text of the locale.

searchRender.zh-CN: 自定义搜索框，参数为对象，包含 `className`、`prefix`、`value`、`onChange`、`showClear` 和 `placeholder`，返回搜索框元素。`onChange` 的参数为输入的字符串。为 `false` 时隐藏内置搜索框。
searchRender.en-US: Renders a custom search box from an object with `className`, `prefix`, `value`, `onChange`, `showClear` and `placeholder`; `onChange` receives the input string. `false` hides the search box.

searchStyle.en-US: Style of the search box container.

showClear.zh-CN: 搜索框是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether the search box shows a clear button.

showFilteredOnly.zh-CN: 搜索时只展示过滤后的结果。
showFilteredOnly.en-US: Shows only the filtered nodes while searching.

showLine.zh-CN: 显示节点之间的连接线。

style.en-US: Style of the root element, typed as `CSSProperties`.

treeData.zh-CN: 节点数据，key 在整棵树内唯一。只有传入新数组才会更新，原地修改数组或节点不会生效。
treeData.en-US: Node data; keys are unique across the tree. Only a new array updates the tree, changes made in place are not seen.

treeDataSimpleJson.zh-CN: 简单 JSON 形式的节点数据，返回值为包含选中节点的 JSON 数据。
treeDataSimpleJson.en-US: Node data as a plain JSON object; the value is a JSON object holding the selected nodes.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时用于匹配输入的节点属性。
treeNodeFilterProp.en-US: The node field matched against the search input.

value.zh-CN: （受控）当前选中节点的 value（没有 value 时为 key）。传入后即为受控组件，配合 onChange 使用；多选时为数组。
value.en-US: Value of the selected node, its key when it has no value (controlled). Passing it makes the tree controlled, used with onChange; an array when multiple.

virtualize.zh-CN: 列表虚拟化，用于大量节点：height、width、itemSize（必传）。开启后动画关闭。
virtualize.en-US: List virtualization for many nodes: height, width and itemSize (required). Animation is off once enabled.

search.zh-CN: 手动触发搜索，效果同在搜索框中输入；需要同时设置 filterTreeNode。
search.en-US: Searches as if the value were typed into the search box; filterTreeNode must be set.

scrollTo.zh-CN: 在虚拟化的 Tree 中，把指定的已展开节点滚动到视图内；参数为 `{ key, align }`，align 默认 `center`。
scrollTo.en-US: In a virtualized tree, scrolls an expanded node into view; takes `{ key, align }`, with align defaulting to `center`.
